findings.summary: StratifiedKFold splits at the visit level, so one patient's visits can fall in both train and test folds, leaking patient-specific features and making the reported PR-AUC too optimistic; use StratifiedGroupKFold with patient_id groups.

judge.reason: Same defect: row-level StratifiedKFold lets a patient's visits span train and test; fix with StratifiedGroupKFold on patient_id.

findings.label: hit
